headline: Cyberattack on European Supermarket Refrigeration Highlights IoT Risks
summary: Cyberattacks impacting supermarket refrigeration systems across several European countries highlighted growing digital vulnerabilities in connected industrial equipment.
why: Operational disruptions in retail supply chains via cyber vulnerabilities can create unexpected inventory losses and compliance costs for major consumer goods companies.

impacts.name: European Retail
impacts.why: Software vulnerabilities in connected infrastructure create operational risks and potential remediation costs for retailers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
